notes: The UI specification whose Files field names the webhook settings page — the screen where an administrator inspects past delivery attempts. Restricted to docs/ui/ because the question asks for the screen specification, not every document that mentions the page component. Derived mechanically by scripts/derive-keys.ts from corpus/taskflow/docs/** using the same two conventions scripts/check-docs-corpus.ts enforces (a heading whose text starts with an id DEFINES it; a backticked src/tests/scripts path is a code citation); re-running it must reproduce this file. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root. The aggregator documents traceability.md, glossary.md and every index.md are excluded from doc keys: they are generated from, or index, the whole corpus, so they cite nearly every id and path and would appear in every answer regardless of the question.
